feed.title: The Soul Library — gated Soul Land fanfiction
feed.subtitle: New chapters and editions from the serials of Gaurav Meena

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — the manhua lens (Ch 7)
entry.summary: The manhua checked and its pacing made law beside the canon voice: open in motion, drawable beats, one-line world-rules. The Sense of Years is the first chapter under both.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — canon-voice batch 2 (Ch 4–6)
entry.summary: The Weight of Blood, The Hunger That Has No Meal, and Greater Than the Wall — rewritten in the canon voice, facts unchanged.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — the canon-voice edition begins (Ch 1–3)
entry.summary: Author ruling: write it like the source. Canon fetched and studied; Chapters 1–3 rewritten in the canon voice (facts unchanged), the rollout continues chapter by chapter.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — Chapter 24, The Stone Country
entry.summary: The opposite country: distance the ruler, the high kinds' teaching, the warmth map, and the thin bargain. The scree wrong — the mountain's memory of noise — and the first pass crossed in the gray kind's company. 2,198 words, PANEL: NONE, sweep PASS 24/24.

entry.title: The Soul Library opens — 5 serials, 181 chapters, 3 ebooks
entry.summary: Every gated serial in one reading site: search, the Sentinel, the Douluo Calendar, prose analytics. Blue Silver Book One, Devouring Dragon Volume One, and the complete Adaptive Prodigy published as EPUBs.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — Chapters 19 & 20 shipped
entry.summary: The North Road (the pacing law's first time-skip chapter) and The Road Itself (the reversal, the first deep meal, the pass country). Sweep PASS 20/20.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — Chapters 19-24 rewritten in plain style
entry.summary: Author ruling: clear and simple, scenes not poetry, not summary. Six chapters rewritten, facts unchanged, all gates re-run.

entry.title: The Soul Library — first audio edition (DD Ch 21)
entry.summary: The Watch and the Pass, read aloud — the Library's first narrated chapter.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — Chapter 23, The Parting
entry.summary: The ford; the water road; the bad ground and the walker; the mountains seen — the pull pointing at the highest whiteness. Sweep PASS 23/23.

entry.title: Devouring Dragon — Chapter 22, The Deep Forest Proper
entry.summary: The walked roads are the camouflage; the fern hall's price; the one unread ground; and THE LEAN — the pull settling east of north. Sweep PASS 22/22.
